name: Breah
fantasy: The quarry-hand. Raises stone out of the ground, climbs it, then punches it into you.
silhouette: the stone shoulder and the huge molten-cracked fists

card.role: Brawler and builder: raises rocks to climb and hide behind, then punches them into the enemy.
card.loop: Brawler and builder: raises rocks to climb and hide behind, then punches them into the enemy.
card.lmb: Rubble Fists: tap to throw a boulder; hold and let go to punch everything in the lane, and every rock in it flies.
card.rmb: Quakefall: hold to gather, let go to hop and slam; the centre stuns. Jump while holding to leap forward.
card.e: Stone Row: raise three rocks ahead. Stand on them, climb them, or punch them into foes.
card.dash: Rubble Rush: dash behind a rock that shoves foes, then rolls on and slows whoever it hits.
card.passive: Tremor Sense: sneak to see enemies in a cone ahead through walls; it widens as you sneak.

weapons.rubble_fists: Tap to throw a boulder; hold and let go to punch everything in the lane, and every rock in it flies.

passive.name: Tremor Sense
passive.desc: While sneaking, a narrow cone ahead (25 degrees, widening to 40 over 2s of sneaking, 16m long) shows every enemy in it through walls and fog as a molten ring, refreshed every half second.

dash.name: Rubble Rush
dash.desc: A rock bursts up in front of you and you barrel 4.2m behind it, shoving whoever it meets. Then it rolls on 6m: 12 damage, a shove, Shred (+15% damage taken for 3s) and a 1.5s slow.

variants.tap: A quick hop and slam just ahead: 14 damage and a shove, the centre stuns, rocks in the ring fly outward.
variants.hold: Hold up to 1.2s: a bigger, harder slam (up to 30) whose growing centre stuns up to 1.2s. Jump while holding to leap forward; punch to lunge.
variants.air: In the air you dive, and slam where you land. A foe caught in the air is spiked down for +40%, +20 more over the abyss.

e.name: Stone Row
e.desc: A red flash on the ground, then three rocks rise in a slight curve 2.2m ahead (on solid ground only, never into bodies). They stop foes and shots, hold 9s, you can stand on and climb them, and any punch, slam or dash-launch sends them flying.

rank3.sec: slamming a foe or a rock gives a Molten Guard shield of 18, up to 4 stacks
rank3.dash: the barrel runs a third further
rank3.kin: a second row of rocks that erupts from its centre outward and slows foes beside it, and cast over the abyss it raises a temporary rock bridge

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; slamming a foe or a rock gives a shield of 18, up to 4 stacks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 13s -> 10.4s; a second row of rocks that slows, and over the abyss a rock bridge.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; the barrel runs a third further.

tells.half: stone pebbles orbit the shoulder, one per live rock
